_doc: Style recipes applied after the base correction (rotate/crop/WB from params). wb/split: CIELAB [a, b] offsets (+b warmer, +a magenta). hue: band -> [hue shift deg, sat delta, lum delta]; bands red 0, orange 30, yellow 55, green 110, aqua 175, blue 220, pink 330. sat/vib global deltas; skin_sat is the skin-mask sat delta (default 0 = skin excluded). curve: [in, out] points. clarity: [amount, blur sigma px @1080]. grain: [sigma, size px @1080]. vignette: [amount, inner radius]. halation: [L threshold, blur as fraction of width, R add, G add]. mono: RGB mix weights.

natural.label: Natural
natural.vibe: The base edit: honest color, gentle contrast, skin-protected vibrance.

clean_editorial.label: Clean Editorial
clean_editorial.vibe: Bright, neutral, crisp. Magazine-clean without looking processed.

portra.label: Portra 400
portra.vibe: Soft film: lifted blacks, creamy highlights, gentle warm skin, muted greens.

kodak_gold.label: Kodak Gold
kodak_gold.vibe: Warm golden-hour film, punchy yellows and reds, a touch of halation.

muted_earth.label: Muted Earth
muted_earth.vibe: Quiet, desaturated earth tones; moody but warm skin.

warm_bw.label: Warm B&W
warm_bw.vibe: Classic warm-toned black and white with fine grain.
